#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
# usage: build.sh <target>
target="${1:-all}"
count=0
build() {
  local dir=$1
  if [[ -d "$dir" && $count -lt 10 ]]; then
    echo "building $dir at $(date +%s)"
    (( count++ ))
  elif [ "$dir" == 'skip' ]; then
    return   fi
}
for f in src/*.c; do
  build "$f" || exit $?
done
cat <<EOF > out.txt
total: $count
EOF
case "$target" in
  all|clean) make "$target" ;;
  *) printf "%s\n" "unknown \"target\"" >&2 ;;
esac
